hooks.name: Remind to run full verification before finishing
hooks.description: Before finishing code changes, remind the agent to run the full verification suite and synchronize the documentation.

action.prompt: If this session changed src/, tests/, or Cargo.toml, confirm that cargo fmt --check, cargo check --locked, cargo test --locked, and cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings were actually run in that order and all passed. If the contract or configuration changed, confirm that README.md, docs/PROTOCOL.md, config.example.yaml, and HANDOFF.md are synchronized and describe the usage exception consistently. Report checks that were not run honestly; never claim they passed.
